claim_boundaries: Do not claim PlanCarry is the first activation procedural memory or first agent activation steering.
Do not call published NPM ALFWorld success directly worse/better than PlanCarry T1 metrics.
Do not retrofit NPM-style repeated injection into PlanCarry T2; repeated injection invalidates the persistence claim.
Do not alter primary T1/T1R thresholds, model, cohort or controls after seeing NPM.
Do not run NPM/system comparison to rescue a null or technically invalid primary T1.

comparability_rules.allowed_use: Published NPM results may establish prior-art strength/context and motivate a system-level matched baseline; do not subtract/ratio published NPM success against PlanCarry T1 CPSE or sign-test metrics.
comparability_rules.reason: Different backbone/model size, task sampling/evaluation protocol, objective and endpoint. NPM published ALFWorld task success is system-level; PlanCarry T1 is a matched causal mechanism test on a frozen family cohort.

PlanCarry_specific_causal_metrics: T1/T2 CPSE and reciprocal donor consistency remain separately reported and are not replaced by success rate
future_mechanism_matched_baseline_if_pri.failure_interpretation: If NPM repeated steering wins end-task success, that does not negate PlanCarry causal persistence; it establishes a system-performance tradeoff. If PlanCarry single injection matches/reaches NPM while using one intervention and smaller episode-local storage, that is stronger evidence for a checkpoint contribution. No conclusion until matched experiment is run.

intervention_frequency_accounting.NPM_STYLE_REPEATED_STEERING: count residual additions per generated token × target layers; report intervention calls/episode and tokens steered
intervention_frequency_accounting.PLANCARRY_SINGLE_INJECTION_CHECKPOINT: one checkpoint injection event at interruption boundary; report patched layers/tokens once; no later reinjection allowed for T2 persistence claim

future_mechanism_matched_baseline_if_pri.preferred_design: Choose a prospectively frozen compatible open backbone/environment where both mechanisms can be implemented on the exact same held-out episodes. Prefer an NPM-supported Qwen3 model only if compute permits; otherwise document model mismatch and run a conceptual/ablative comparator rather than pretending exact reproduction.

storage_accounting.NPM: report historical-repository bytes/task or trajectory, retrieval metadata, number of stored vectors/layers, dtype; paper example 45 KB/trajectory for Qwen3-4B 3 layers FP16
storage_accounting.PlanCarry: report checkpoint bytes/episode, number of vectors/tokens/layers and dtype; T3 must establish endogenous extraction/minimality before calling it a deployment memory object

future_mechanism_matched_baseline_if_pri.trigger: Only after valid corrected-v2.6 primary confirmation is SUPPORTED_T1; do not run to rescue a null/inconclusive/invalid T1.

method.intervention: inject synthesized task-specific steering vector into residual stream at each autoregressive generation time step
method.memory_source: historical task trajectories; inter-trajectory success-vs-failure and intra-trajectory effective-vs-degenerate contrasts
method.storage: three hidden-state representations per historical trajectory per target layer (one inter last-token state; two intra pooled states)
method.strength: dynamic discrete scale selection constrained by next-token KL divergence threshold
method.synthesis: retrieve top-K similar historical tasks (paper K=8), form contrast pool, mean-center paired activations, derive dominant PCA direction

npm.paper: Neural Procedural Memory: Empowering LLM Agents with Implicit Activation Steering
npm.paper_training_data: training-split tasks; 16 sampled trajectories/task, temperature 0.7, top-p 0.8, top-k 20; ALFWorld max 50 turns; retrieval K=8
npm.published_storage_example: Qwen3-4B, hidden d=2560, FP16, 3 target layers: paper reports 45 KB per historical trajectory.

planCarry_corrected_primary.T2_future_endpoint: same causal plan state injected once, then common action/observation prefix in same persistent session with no reinjection/recomputed patch; later donor-consistent divergent branch effect
planCarry_corrected_primary.current_T1_endpoint: matched-reset episode-specific active-plan identity; reciprocal first-divergent branch causal effect and specificity controls

web_evidence_notes: arXiv 2606.29824v1 §3.3 states steering vector is injected at each autoregressive time step
